groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: Newly tracked leak site; aggregators show its first named victim in early November 2026. Dumped 13 names on RansomLook in a single batch at one timestamp, many with descriptive detail in the title — no samples visible in the feed. Treat as low-confidence until corroborated.

groups.name: Akira
groups.profile: Active since March 2023; double extortion with Windows/ESXi encryptors; frequent abuse of VPN credentials without MFA. Consistently one of the most prolific groups, heavily weighted to U.S. SMB manufacturing and services.

groups.name: Inc Ransom
groups.profile: Active since mid-2023; double extortion; known for exploiting edge devices and spear-phishing; history of healthcare, education and public-sector victims in the U.S., UK and Australia.

groups.name: Play
groups.profile: Active since mid-2022; intermittent encryption; historically exploits FortiOS/Exchange flaws. Posts in batches with "United States" boilerplate descriptions.

groups.name: Aoqin
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site (styled "Aoqin Leaks" on RansomLook); posts revenue, staff counts and publication deadlines. Two of its three RansomLook entries today were reposts.

groups.name: Bravox
groups.profile: Recently tracked leak site with sporadic postings; limited public reporting on TTPs.

groups.name: Dark Project
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; posts detailed stolen-data descriptions with volume and file counts.

groups.name: Doommageddon
groups.profile: Little-documented operation; lists victims with negotiation status and deadline.

groups.name: Emperador
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; posts company profile plus a sample-release countdown.

groups.name: Hyflock
groups.profile: Unknown/new name in RansomLook; single ambiguous post.

groups.name: Interlock
groups.profile: Active since September 2024; fake browser-update/ClickFix initial access, RATs and data theft; education and healthcare heavy.

groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: Emerged in 2025; high-volume poster (23 RansomLook entries in the current feed, most outside this window); reported to abuse Group Policy for deployment.

groups.name: Wallstreet
groups.profile: Little-documented name; its only post in the window is a household-brand claim with no evidence in the feed.
